beats.narration: An item is scheduled, and the ones already overdue are flagged the moment the page loads.
Deadlines slip through when nothing surfaces them, and reminders get sent late or never.
Add a title and a due time, right from the dashboard.
Anything past its due time is flagged for a reminder automatically.
The flagged count updates live, so a team sees exactly what needs a reminder sent.
One list, every overdue item caught, no reminder missed.
